Dark theme for plotly plots

Source: R/plot_theme.R
theme_dark_plotly.Rd

Apply a consistent dark theme to plotly visualizations with dark background, white text/labels, and subtle grey gridlines. Inspired by tonyelhabr aesthetics.

Usage

theme_dark_plotly(p, title = NULL)

Arguments

p

A plotly object.

title

Optional plot title.

Value

A styled plotly object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(plotly)
p <- plot_ly(mtcars, x = ~mpg, y = ~hp, type = "scatter", mode = "markers")
theme_dark_plotly(p, title = "MPG vs Horsepower")
} # }
